01 · About

Software developer building web applications, backend systems and AI-powered products.

I’m Hailstones, a software developer working across full-stack web development, backend and API development, and AI-powered systems. I build software end to end: the interface people use, the APIs and data behind it, and the AI features that make it more useful.

My projects range from AI-powered platforms and business networking tools to security-focused applications and games. I care about software that is reliable, well structured and practical, and I keep widening what I can build by working on real products.

I’m also the creator of the GHOST CTS series of browser games.

Professional experience: Worked with ANDAV TECH. VENTURES for two years, contributing to its digital and technology work.

  • Software engineeringBuilding complete products, from first idea to live deployment.
  • Backend and API developmentDesigning and integrating APIs, server-side logic and data management.
  • AI systems and automationIntegrating AI APIs into assistants, narration, automation and business tools.
  • Full-stack webResponsive interfaces connected to real back ends.

06 · Journey

How my work has grown

I haven’t followed one straight path. My work has widened as each project raised new questions.

  1. Games and interactive workBrowser games, including the GHOST CTS series, taught me to build things people use directly.
    GHOST CTS 3GHOST CTS 4
  2. Teaching through playGHOST CTS 4 teaches Python inside a shooter, which pushed me to make technical ideas clear and playable.
    PythonGame design
  3. Platforms and business toolsGhost Night Stories and VentureSpace took my work into full platforms: content, profiles, search, messaging and dashboards.
    Ghost Night StoriesVentureSpace
  4. Client and company websitesANDAV TECH. VENTURES brought client-facing work: a professional site for a registered company offering technology, design, printing and training.
    ANDAV TECH. VENTURES
  5. Backend, data and securityGrey Vault led me toward APIs, storage and encryption on the server side.
    Grey VaultEncryption
